cat > /workspace/gen_big.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys
random.seed(123)
# stream big
Q=16;L=8;U=2147483648
R=32
# borders strictly increasing 0..U with 32 ranges
cuts=sorted(random.sample(range(1,U),R-1))
borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
C=20000;E=1
nsteps=15000
steps=[]
t=0
cid=0
for k in range(nsteps):
    t+=1
    arr=[]
    for ln in range(L):
        cid+=1
        arr.append({"id":"p%d"%cid,"lane":ln,"rank":random.randint(0,U-1)})
    steps.append({"t":t,"serve":True,"arrivals":arr})
obj={"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,"capacity":C,"epoch":E,"steps":steps}
open('/workspace/big_stream.json','w').write(json.dumps(obj))
print("stream attempts",cid)

# burst big
N=120000
pkts=[]
for i in range(N):
    pkts.append({"id":"x%d"%i,"lane":random.randrange(L),"rank":random.randint(0,U-1)})
obj2={"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,"start_bank":5,"packets":pkts}
open('/workspace/big_burst.json','w').write(json.dumps(obj2))
print("burst",N)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 gen_big.py && ls -la big_*.json
echo "--- stream timing ---"
/usr/bin/time -v python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < /workspace/big_stream.json > /workspace/out_stream.json 2> /workspace/time_stream.txt; tail -n 20 /workspace/time_stream.txt
echo "--- burst timing ---"
/usr/bin/time -v python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < /workspace/big_burst.json > /workspace/out_burst.json 2> /workspace/time_burst.txt; tail -n 20 /workspace/time_burst.txt
wc -c /workspace/out_stream.json /workspace/out_burst.json
